parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the response. Valid values:

*   **zh** (default): Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-download-task-type --lang zh --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --task-type InternetFirewallAsset --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw DescribeDownloadTaskType --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --CurrentPage 1 --TaskType InternetFirewallAsset --Lang zh
